visual.description: A close-up of a man's intense, focused eye as the pupil dilates significantly.

vo.en: Quickly, what is two plus two? Now four plus four? Eight plus eight? And sixteen plus sixteen?

visual.description: Fast-paced shots of glowing neon mathematical symbols and numbers flying through a dark space.

vo.en: Faster! Pick a whole number between twelve and five. Keep it in your head.

visual.description: A man's hand rapidly scribbling numbers on a transparent glass board with a white marker.

vo.en: But here is the creepy part. Quickly, think of a color and a tool right now.

visual.description: Intricate mechanical clock gears turning and locking into place rapidly inside a vintage watch.

vo.en: Your brain just hit a semantic priming glitch, defaulting to the most common mental association possible.

visual.description: A 3D digital visualization of a neural network with electric pulses firing between synapses.

vo.en: You just thought of a Red Hammer. Most people choose exactly that.

visual.description: A heavy red-handled hammer striking a nail on a wooden workbench in cinematic slow motion.

vo.en: Subscribe for tomorrow's brain test and comment YES if this worked on you, because...

visual.description: A hand holding a smartphone, tapping the screen to hit a digital notification bell icon.
